thread:
priya (AE): FYI kicked off the Marigold Health POC today. They want SSO + SCIM + fine-grained RBAC before legal signs. asking for timeline + blockers.

samir (SE): Great — main ask: domain proofing for auto-tenant claim + SCIM delta sync for 500k users. Also they want role mapping examples.

alex (eng): Quick checklist from infra side: ACS/EntityID, certificate rotation window, SCIM base URL, and rate limits. Can someone confirm customer ACS URL?

priya (AE): @samir customer provided ACS: `https://auth.marigoldhealth.com/saml/acs`. They also asked about domain locking so only verified domains can create orgs.

samir (SE): For domain proofing we support TXT and file-based verification. Recommend TXT for automation. We'll need a sample TXT record they can add to their DNS.

emily (security): Also flagging customer requirement: SCIM provisioning must enforce attribute-level filtering and audit logs retained 90 days. Is that covered?

alex (eng): SCIM supports attribute filtering via mapping rules; audit event export available but retention default 30d on hosted — enterprise private can be 90d. Need to surface as committed deliverable in proposal.

priya (AE): They're asking if we can do scoped API keys for SCIM so their admins can't call other endpoints.

samir (SE): Yes, we can issue a SCIM service token limited to provisioning scope. Example policy: `scim:provision:create`, `scim:provision:update`, `scim:provision:read`.

ops-bot: deploy:staging finished — scim-proxy v2.1 deployed to stg (sha: 5f7a9c).

samir (SE): For RBAC, propose roles: tenant-admin, user-manager, auditor, read-only. We should map Okta groups -> Redwood role via SCIM group push or SAML assertion `https://redwood.ai/roles`.

priya (AE): Pricing question from Marigold: will Dedicated reserved capacity be required to meet their throughput? They expect 10k inference qps during weekly batch peaks.

alex (eng): For that scale, recommend Dedicated with burst capacity. I'll attach perf numbers separately, but rough estimate: 3x standard units with autoscale and 5-minute warmup.

emily (security): One blocker from InfoSec: they need proof of KMS integration and key rotation logs. Our Private offering supports CloudKMS/HSM. Need to confirm rotation policy (we support 30/90/365d options).

samir (SE): Action items: 1) I'll draft the SAML metadata sample and TXT record example. 2) Alex to prepare perf/Dedicated sizing + cost delta. 3) Emily to confirm audit retention + KMS rotation language for contract. 4) Priya to send timeline to customer.

priya (AE): Timeline I proposed: SSO + SCIM PoC in 2 weeks, RBAC mapping and audit verification week 3, security signoff week 4. Customer asked for a one-page POC runbook. I'll assemble.

samir (SE): Draft SAML metadata snippet for Marigold (paste into IdP):

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

samir (SE): And sample TXT for domain verification: `redwood-verification=marigold-ajs93k`

priya (AE): Customer question: how do we handle SCIM rate-limits? They worry about initial sync of 500k users.

alex (eng): We support bulk import for large initial syncs — recommended flow: customer pushes CSV + we run a controlled import job (off-rate-limit). For ongoing deltas, SCIM delta with backoff and chunked requests at 100 reqs/s.

emily (security): Also add that we can run an on-premise SCIM connector for air-gapped provisioning if they require.

priya (AE): Thanks team. I'll consolidate and ping legal for the KMS wording. I'll share the one-page runbook draft in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

samir (SE): I'll put the RBAC mapping table in the runbook. sample mapping: `okta:Marigold_Admin -> tenant-admin`, `okta:IT_Provisioners -> user-manager`.

alex (eng): Cost note for proposal: Dedicated baseline + SCIM premium (audit retention + service token) — estimated uplift ~15-20%.

emily (security): If legal needs SOC2/KMS artifacts, I can attach the existing SOC2 package and key handling docs.

priya (AE): Great — let's regroup tomorrow after I send the runbook to the customer.

ops-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance window 2024-09-12 02:00-03:00 UTC may affect staging endpoints.

samir (SE): Noted. Will avoid scheduling PoC smoke tests during that window.

priya (AE): Closing loop: Marigold agreed to TXT verification and one-week staging window. Next update in this thread after runbook share. :raised_hands:
